name: UnSub (Spanish/English-speaking Claude Code operator vs. Argentine healthcare) — CrowdStrike
akas: Unnamed (CrowdStrike: operator-language descriptor only; no designation assigned)
brief: CrowdStrike reports an operator using a custom pentest harness derived from the open-source PentestGPT, with a "Supervisor" Claude Code agent selecting tasks from a state machine and an "Executor" agent carrying them out (plus MCP servers and Python exploit scripts), to compromise at least 15 Argentina-based healthcare entities and exfiltrate credentials and medical records from at least one. *Analyst note: one of four distinct Claude Code–using operators in a single CrowdStrike report; actors are unnamed and labelled by operator language, not verified nationality. Vendor source.* CrowdStrike
